Inquiry held under Section 02 of the powers of Supervision of the Administration of the Local Authorities
Statute, No. 04 of 1991 of the Western Province Provincial Council

I, Isura Devapriya, the Chief Minister and the Minister of Finance and Planning, Engineering Services, Law and Order, LocalGovernment and Provincial Administration, Economic Development, Power and Energy, Enviornmental Affairs, WaterSupply and Drainage and Tourism of the Western Province Provincial Council do hereby announce that the inquiry periodwill be extended to 2nd August of the Single Person Tribunal comprising retired Judge of High Court Hon. Kumara HewageSumithrapala appointed on 21st March 2016 by the Extraordinary Gazette Paper No. 1959/7 of the Democratic SocialistRepublic of Sri Lanka as per the powers entrusted to me by the provisions of Section 2(2) of the Powers of Supervision ofthe Administration of Local Authorities Statute No. 04 of 1991 of the Western Province Provincial Council to inquire andsubmit a report based on the following matters/allegations within 03 months, whether the Mayor of Moratuwa MunicipalCouncil, W. Samanlal Fernando, while functioning in his office has made the offences stated under Section 2(1) of theaforementioned statute.
ISURA DEVAPRIYA,Chief Minister, Minister of Finance and Planning, Engineering Services,
Law and Order, Local Government and Provincial Administration,Economic Development, Power and Energy, Environmental Affairs,
Water Supply and Drainage and Tourism of
Chief Minister of Western Provincial Council,Shrawasthi Mandiraya,Colombo 07,29th June 2016.
